catalog.get_dataset_schema.name: catalog.get_dataset_schema
catalog.get_dataset_schema.description: Read one Davinci dataset's metadata, requiredFilters, grainFieldRefs and at most `limit` (default 50) authorized fields. Narrow with `fieldRefs` (exact fields) or `query`/`roles` (ranked); with neither, structural fields (required filters, grain, time) come first. Check `fieldCount`/`truncated`. For ranked field discovery across datasets use catalog.search_fields. Reuse canonical refs from tool output: datasetRef='warehouseTopic:10', fieldRefs=['warehouseTopic:10/12285']; bare numeric IDs are invalid.

catalog.search_datasets.name: catalog.search_datasets
catalog.search_datasets.description: For an unbound metric choice, start with limit=3,maxMatchedFields=3. Once matchedFields definitions distinguish the choices, present dataset, metric and real definition options and wait for the user; do not inspect unrelated Widgets or prepare containers to infer their choice. Missing returned field definitions are supplemented internally from at most two authorized dataset schemas, concurrently, without expanding the field list. FIELD_DEFINITIONS_NOT_RETURNED means some definitions remain unavailable; check LOOKUP_FAILED/LOOKUP_LIMIT_REACHED issues and explain that limit, not that the source has no definition. Do not repeat these schema reads. If no relevant fields were found, supplement once with search_fields within at most two found datasets. Discovery-only requests should list the findings without forcing a choice. Find Davinci datasets using explainable catalog evidence and live access checks. Returns the top `limit` (default 5) ranked candidates from a bounded recall pool, not a complete inventory. Follow nextCursor with unchanged search arguments to traverse pages. coverage describes only this keyword search; check issues for partial failure or bounded multi-term fallback, never claim a global inventory. matchedFields retain the field definitions.

catalog.list_dataset_usages.name: catalog.list_dataset_usages
catalog.list_dataset_usages.description: List accessible dashboards associated with one authorized datasetRef. Read-only CUSTOM/SPACE candidates only; dataset association does not prove a particular field is used. Check truncated/issues; V1 and other Watcher resource coverage is not established. Returns dashboardId and spaceUid for navigation.

analytics.resolve_data_requirements.name: analytics.resolve_data_requirements
analytics.resolve_data_requirements.description: Assemble permission-safe dataset and field bindings only after the business meaning and target fields are already confirmed. For an unbound request, first use catalog.search_datasets to find candidates and clarify genuine alternatives. If this tool returns need_clarification, present its existing dataset, field and definition evidence and wait for the user; do not inspect unrelated existing Widgets or prepare containers, queries or writes. Other outcomes report permission or relation requirements.
